name: AUTH-03 token 过期/失效 → 401 → 自动 refresh → 重试成功

setup.code: const c = globalThis.__cloudMock; if (!c) throw new Error('cloud-mock 未注入'); c.reset(); c.setScenario({ login: { responses: [{ status: 401, body: { error: { code: 'AUTH_INVALID' } } }] }, refresh: { responses: [{ status: 200, body: () => ({ accessToken: c.issueToken({ ttlMs: 3600e3 }), expiresIn: 3600, refreshToken: 'e2e-refresh-2', refreshExpiresIn: 2592000 }) }] }, put: { responses: [{ status: 401, body: { error: { code: 'AUTH_INVALID', message: 'expired' } } }, { status: 200, body: { rev: 2, previousRev: 1 } }] } }); wx.clearStorageSync(); const expired = c.issueToken({ ttlMs: -1000 }); wx.setStorageSync('cloudSession', JSON.stringify({ accessToken: expired, refreshToken: 'e2e-refresh-old', user: null, savedAt: Date.now() })); const app = getApp(); return { loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), usable: app.cloudAuth.hasUsableAccess() };

steps.code: const app = getApp(); return { loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), usable: app.cloudAuth.hasUsableAccess(), session: JSON.parse(wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession') || 'null') };

const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p.data.devices[0]; if (!d) throw new Error('设备列表为空：扫描未发现 ML-8DCC'); return p.onTapDevice({ currentTarget: { dataset: { deviceId: d.deviceId, name: d.name } } });
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { route: p.route, deviceId: p.data.deviceId, connected: !!p.data.connected, error: p.data.error || '' };

const c = globalThis.__cloudMock; const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const st = c.getState(); if (st.counts.put >= 2 && st.last.put && st.last.put.status === 200) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } const st = c.getState(); const reqs = c.getRequests(); const app = getApp(); const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { counts: st.counts, putStatuses: reqs.filter((r) => r.route === 'put').map((r) => r.status), refreshStatuses: reqs.filter((r) => r.route === 'refresh').map((r) => r.status), sessionRefreshToken: (JSON.parse(wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession') || 'null') || {}).refreshToken || null, connected: !!(p && p.data.connected) };
